note: Numeric values are project gameplay tuning derived from existing qualitative lore/faction profiles. They are not canon statistics and never attach by species alone.

united_federation_of_planets.interpretation: Strong institutional/negotiated restraint with defensive force available when authority, threat and necessity justify it.

klingon_empire.interpretation: Imperial/House/honor context can make overt coercion and force more acceptable, but House politics, leadership, capability and era remain decisive.

vulcan_mainstream_context.interpretation: Logic-centered restraint and analysis favor de-escalation when rational; force remains possible when evidence/necessity supports it. This is not an independent war-declaration authority profile.

romulan_star_empire.interpretation: Security awareness and strategic ambiguity support indirect/covert pressure as an available political tool; they do not make every Romulan deceptive.

cardassian_union.interpretation: State hierarchy, security and strategic-control context can support coercive action; era/government changes are mandatory inputs.

ferengi_alliance.interpretation: Commercial bargaining and negotiated advantage are strong contextual priors; no Ferengi individual inherits this policy automatically.

dominion.interpretation: Hierarchical strategic control can support coercion, infiltration or force; actual Founder/Vorta/Jem'Hadar authority and assignment state remain required.

rules: Profiles are starting context only; campaign World State can move policy substantially.
Do not attach a profile because an NPC shares a species label.
Vulcan cultural context may affect actors with that culture_ref but cannot itself declare war.
Klingon Imperial context applies to actual Imperial decision structures, not every Klingon.
